description: This file contains test cases written using pytest and asyncio for testing team management endpoints in a backend service, including creation, update, deletion of teams and members, as well as budget enforcement and cost tracking functionalities.

methods.name: get_user_info(session, get_user, call_user, view_all: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Fetches user info from the /user/info endpoint and handles access control based on provided user identifiers.

methods.name: wait_for_team_member_spend_update( session, user_id, team_id, expected_min_spend, max_wait=10 )
methods.description: Polls the user info until the team member spend is updated to at least the expected minimum or timeout occurs.

methods.name: new_user( session, i, user_id=None, budget=None, budget_duration=None, models=["azure-models"], team_id=None, user_email=None, )
methods.description: Creates a new user via the /user/new endpoint with optional budget and team parameters.

methods.name: add_member( session, i, team_id, user_id=None, user_email=None, max_budget=None, members=None )
methods.description: Adds a member to a team via the /team/member_add endpoint.

methods.name: update_member( session, i, team_id, user_id=None, user_email=None, max_budget=None, )
methods.description: Updates a team member's information via the /team/member_update endpoint.

methods.name: delete_member(session, i, team_id, user_id=None, user_email=None)
methods.description: Removes a member from a team via the /team/member_delete endpoint.

methods.name: generate_key( session, i, budget=None, budget_duration=None, models=["azure-models", "gpt-4", "dall-e-3"], team_id=None, )
methods.description: Generates an API key associated with a team or models via the /key/generate endpoint.

methods.name: chat_completion(session, key, model="gpt-4")
methods.description: Performs a chat completion request to the /chat/completions endpoint, attempting multiple times if necessary.

methods.name: new_team(session, i, user_id=None, member_list=None, model_aliases=None)

methods.name: update_team(session, i, team_id, user_id=None, member_list=None, **kwargs)
